content.body:
The reliable Lee-Enfield No.4 was also employed as a sniper weapon. A Mk 3 Scope was added with 3x magnification.
Snipers were often recruited from the finest marksman in the force. They were assigned to hit high-value targets. Snipers were so highly-valued and respected among themselves that they often followed their own code of ethics. Among these ethical rules was that a sniper would not kill an enemy sniper unless it was absolutely necessary.
content.brief: WEAPON: Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I Rifle AMMO: .303 cal (7.7 mm) British Mk VII Ball MAGAZINE: 10 rounds (two stripper clips) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 751 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round bolt action OTHER EQUIPMENT: Mk 3 Telescopic Sight Webley .455 cal (11.6 mm) Revolver No.77 Mk I Smoke Grenades (4) Combat Knife
